About the company

OJSC «Attelkom»

Attelkom is the largest telecommunications company of Irad. Since 1994 we connect people, business and the state. Today Attelkom serves more than 2.6 million mobile subscribers and operates the main fibre backbone, international gateways and the national data centre.

History

1994Foundation of the company under the telecommunications contract of Talas Air Base. Modernisation of telephone exchanges of Talas.
1996First dial-up internet in Irad. Registration of the domain zone .ir.ad.
1 March 1997Opening of the Attelkom Online portal (www.attelkom.net). Launch of the first GSM mobile network in central Talas.
12 October 1998Launch of Attelkom Jarnama, the advertising network of the Attelkom Online portal.
17 June 1999Transformation into an open joint-stock company.
3 April 2000Dial-up numbers and a point of presence in Nurzhan.
2 September 2002Opening of the new headquarters and network operations centre on Communications Square.
15 September 2003School Connection Project with the Ministry of Education: the first schools online.
15 November 2004Launch of Kündölük, the blog service for subscribers.
28 October 2005Fibre backbone reaches Nurzhan and Iyık Janyl.
8 December 2008Opening of the service status page.
20 May 2010Launch of 3G in Talas, Nurzhan and Iyık Janyl.
3 April 2012Attelkom Pay: SMS payments and transfers with Talasbank.
15 June 2016Launch of 4G/LTE in three cities.
22 April 2019New corporate website and logo.
2026Network modernisation of the international gateways (June). Connection to a regional traffic exchange point (August). 4G in all district centres of Kara-Buura (October).
